description: Only keeps the tools' shared Postgres image current (patch, minor and digest within 16.x). Every other dependency in this repo is left alone on purpose; widen enabledManagers to onboard more.

customManagers.description: postgres image in Helm values, the tool-library default and docs (image: postgres:<tag>@sha256:<digest>)

packageRules.description: Postgres majors need a dump/restore or pg_upgrade; an in-place tag bump breaks the data directory.
All postgres image bumps (patch, minor, digest) in one PR, automerged after 2 days during the day once CI passes.
